articles.summary: The all-new Pod 6 packs nine times more biometric sensors into the Cover than Pod 5, up from one primary sensor per side to nine. It’s the single biggest change the sensing system has ever seen.
articles.title: More accurate than ever: The sensors in Pod 6

articles.summary: Previous generations of the Pod were built around one assumption: a double-size bed, for up to two sleepers. With the introduction of Solo sizes with Pod 6, we’re bringing award-winning sleep technology to more setups and ways of sleeping than ever before.
articles.title: Meet Pod 6 Solo: A Pod sized for one
